name: Video_SetModeX
note: INT10 13h; DAC black; unchain; CRTC 320x240 60Hz; offset 0x30 (384 px rows); attr mode 0x61; clears 256 KiB

name: Video_WaitVSync
note: waits for start of next retrace

name: Tiles_DrawColumnsParallax
note: 22x13 tiles one plane; tile byte 0x80 -> backdrop byte (linear 320 stride)

name: Video_ReadPixel
note: (x;y;base) returns v-0x80 if 0x80<=v<=0xC0 else 0; used as collision probe

name: Video_NightStub
note: empty function called each frame when !g_NightPalActive

name: Sprite_Queue
note: (x;y;id) x+=fineX; y+=16+fineY; id>0x8000 mirrored; wrap flag if left<0

name: Sprite_DrawQueue
note: draws entries count-1..0 (first queued on top); wrap -> x+384

name: Font_DrawSmallGlyph
note: returns rightmost column; colour 255 or 254 at night

name: Video_FlipPage
note: start=back+0x600+fine; 1+g_VSyncWaits vsyncs; Pal_CycleEffects if g_FlashCounter; swap pages

name: Pal_Fade
note: (first;last;type;steps) 0 out 1 in 2 half-out 3 half-in; ignored if type==last type; restores g_Palette

name: Video_DrawLine
note: asm DDA; steep lines degenerate to vertical (16-bit step in 32-bit acc)

name: Tiles_ParallaxBench
note: benchmark copy of the parallax loop

name: Tiles_ClearColumns
note: benchmark: copies from linear address 0 into page B

name: Video_CountVSync
note: polls until next retrace start; returns poll count

name: Pal_CycleEffects
note: night: flash table on colour 64 (detail off) or sky ramp 192..207 (detail on)

name: Pal_NightAltitude
note: night altitude lighting of 64..79 128..143 192..207 from g_PalSaved

name: Pal_SaveNight
note: saves palette; colour 254 dark red; dead grey table; forces altitude refresh

name: g_PicFullLoad
note: Pic_LoadPax clears page + loads pal when 1

name: g_NightPalActive
note: night lighting active (font colour 254; altitude palette)

name: g_NightGreyTab
note: 16x16 ints written by Pal_SaveNight; never read

name: g_ScrollFineX
note: renamed from g_ShakeX: = g_CamX&15 (fine scroll; no shake)

name: g_FlashTable
note: indexed by g_FlashCounter; rows of 10 from 0x90fe8 (GENDATA.DAX)
